basicimageeditorfile:
{{doc-special|BasicImageEditorFile|unlisted=1}}
The page serves raw image data to the editor and is not meant to be visited directly.
basicimageeditor-title:
Page title of the editor.

Parameters:
* $1 – name of the file being edited, without the namespace prefix
basicimageeditor-tab: Label of the tab on file description pages that opens the editor.
basicimageeditor-loading: Shown while the editor's JavaScript loads.
basicimageeditor-cancel:
{{Identical|Cancel}}
Button that leaves the editor and returns to the file page.
basicimageeditor-error-notarget: Error shown when the editor is opened without a file name.
basicimageeditor-error-uploads-disabled: Error shown when uploads are disabled on the wiki.
basicimageeditor-error-readonly: Error shown when the wiki is in read-only mode.
basicimageeditor-error-nofile:
Error shown when the named file does not exist.

Parameters:
* $1 – the page title that was given, including the namespace prefix
basicimageeditor-error-remote: Error shown for files from a shared repository such as Wikimedia Commons.
basicimageeditor-error-format: Error shown for files that are not JPG or PNG images.
basicimageeditor-error-toolarge:
Error shown when the image has more pixels than the configured limit.

Parameters:
* $1 – the limit in pixels
basicimageeditor-error-anon: Error shown to users who are not logged in.
basicimageeditor-error-permission: Error shown when the user lacks the rights to overwrite the file, is blocked, or the file is protected.
basicimageeditor-error-reupload: Error shown when the user only has the right to overwrite their own uploads and someone else uploaded the current version.
basicimageeditor-load-error:
Shown when the image cannot be loaded into the editor.

Parameters:
* $1 – technical reason, in English
basicimageeditor-stage-label: Accessible label of the area showing the image and the crop box.
basicimageeditor-keyboard-help: Help text below the image explaining mouse and keyboard cropping.
basicimageeditor-tool-crop:
Label of the crop ratio selector.
{{Identical|Crop}}
basicimageeditor-ratio-original: Crop ratio option: same shape as the image.
basicimageeditor-rotate-left: Button that rotates the image 90° counter-clockwise.
basicimageeditor-rotate-right: Button that rotates the image 90° clockwise.
basicimageeditor-flip-horizontal: Button that mirrors the image left to right.
basicimageeditor-flip-vertical: Button that mirrors the image top to bottom.
basicimageeditor-tool-straighten: Label of the slider for fine rotation.
basicimageeditor-degrees:
An angle in degrees.

Parameters:
* $1 – the number, such as 2.5
basicimageeditor-save:
Button that saves the edited image.
{{Identical|Save}}
basicimageeditor-target-label: Label of the choice between saving a new version and a new file.
basicimageeditor-target-version: Save option: upload the edited image as a new version of the same file.
basicimageeditor-target-new: Save option: upload the edited image as a separate file.
basicimageeditor-all-uses-warning: Warning in the save dialog when saving a new version.
basicimageeditor-newname-label: Label of the file name input for a new file.
basicimageeditor-newname-help:
Help below the new file name input.

Parameters:
* $1 – the file extension with a leading dot, such as .jpg
basicimageeditor-newname-empty: Error when the new file name is empty.
basicimageeditor-newname-same: Error when the new file name equals the original.
basicimageeditor-newname-exists:
Error when a file with the new name already exists.

Parameters:
* $1 – the file name
basicimageeditor-summary-label:
Label of the edit summary input.
{{Identical|Summary}}
basicimageeditor-summary-crop: Part of the default edit summary. Parts are joined with commas and the first letter is capitalised.
basicimageeditor-summary-rotate: Part of the default edit summary; see {{msg-mw|basicimageeditor-summary-crop}}.
basicimageeditor-summary-flip: Part of the default edit summary; see {{msg-mw|basicimageeditor-summary-crop}}.
basicimageeditor-summary-straighten: Part of the default edit summary; see {{msg-mw|basicimageeditor-summary-crop}}.
basicimageeditor-summary-brightness: Part of the default edit summary; see {{msg-mw|basicimageeditor-summary-crop}}.
basicimageeditor-summary-contrast: Part of the default edit summary; see {{msg-mw|basicimageeditor-summary-crop}}.
basicimageeditor-derived-from:
Wikitext line added to the description page of a new file made from another file.

Parameters:
* $1 – title of the source file, including the namespace
basicimageeditor-saving: Accessible label of the progress bar while saving.
basicimageeditor-error-result-toolarge:
Error when the edited image exceeds the upload size limit.

Parameters:
* $1 – the limit, such as "100 MB"
basicimageeditor-error-save:
Error when saving fails.

Parameters:
* $1 – the reason given by the wiki
basicimageeditor-conflict-title: Title of the dialog shown when the file changed while the editor was open.
basicimageeditor-conflict-overwrite: Conflict dialog button that saves over the newer version.
basicimageeditor-conflict-new: Conflict dialog button that switches to saving a new file.
basicimageeditor-warnings-title: Title of the dialog listing upload warnings.
basicimageeditor-warnings-text: Introduction to the list of upload warnings.
basicimageeditor-warnings-continue: Button that saves despite the warnings.
basicimageeditor-warning-duplicate:
Upload warning.

Parameters:
* $1 – comma-separated list of file names
basicimageeditor-warning-badfilename:
Upload warning.

Parameters:
* $1 – the corrected file name
basicimageeditor-warning-other:
Upload warning without a specific message.

Parameters:
* $1 – the warning code from the upload API
basicimageeditor-saved: Notification on the file page after the edited image was saved.
tag-basicimageeditor: Short description of the basicimageeditor change tag, shown in lists of changes.
tag-basicimageeditor-description: Long description of the basicimageeditor change tag, shown on [[Special:Tags]].
